feeling: A small machine's five-note tune caught in a fast low line that will not stop, wound faster until it wrecks everything, and then faster still.
intent: Zappy at full scale in glass-acid's world, for zappy's own video: zappy's five notes as the loud notes of the same kind of fast low line, in the same sound, speeding up into a break, a near silence, and a return that is faster than anything before it. Nobody has heard it: it was checked by measurement only.
listen_for: Zappy's five notes as the loud notes in the low line from 0:04; the hammering from 0:25; the clock alone with the little tune at 0:38; and the tune at half speed over everything from 0:43, the fastest part.

parts.name: thin
parts.change: a low line of fast notes alone, over a tick and a tock
parts.feels: thin, wound up: a clock and a wire

parts.name: hello
parts.change: zappy's five notes appear as the loud notes of the line, bright then dark
parts.feels: small, eager, and then told otherwise

parts.name: build
parts.change: a kick on every beat, a low bass, the line with no gaps; then a climb

parts.name: faster
parts.change: the tune at double speed and up high, each bar starting higher; chords stab

parts.name: destruction
parts.change: three notes of the tune hammered twice a bar, everything loud

parts.name: silence
parts.change: the clock alone and the five notes, very quiet

parts.name: return
parts.change: the fastest tempo; the tune at half speed over everything, then at speed
parts.feels: the real size of it, and still accelerating

parts.name: home
parts.change: the home note hammered, a run up two octaves, one blow
